title: U.S. Marines with Heavy Marine Helicopter Squadron (HMH) 461 rehearse to transit an F-35B Lightning II
description: U.S. Marines with Marine Heavy Helicopter Squadron (HMH) 461, Marine Aircraft Group 29, 2nd Marine Aircraft Wing (MAW), rehearse to transport an F-35B Lightning II near Naval Air Station Patuxent River, Maryland, Aug. 26, 2025. The F-35, known as BF-1, was the first F-35 to perform a vertical landing and was transported to Marine Corps Air Station Beaufort, South Carolina, for use as a permanent static display. (U.S. Marine Corps photo by Lance Cpl. Bryan Giraldo)
